title: Game’s Price Is Lower Because This Fall Is So Packed, Dev Admits
description: October is going to be a tough month for anyone on a budget, as a ton of big games are coming up. Sandwiched between an already-packed September and the November release of GTA 6, how does any game stand out from the pack? In the case of Valor Mortis, a launch price of $40--and day-one availability via Xbox Game Pass--might be a winning combination to help it shift units. "We've had many discussions over the past year about the price of Valor Mortis," developer One More Level and publisher Lyrical Games wrote in a statement. "We believe the game has the quality, fidelity, and playtime in its 20-hour story to go toe-to-toe with many 'full price' titles. Still, this fall is stacked, and there's high demand for your time and money." https://twitter.com/ValorMortis/status/2100570811677770189 One More Level added that cosmetic packs will also be released in the next few months, and if players want to support the studio, they can purchase a Deluxe Edition that includes unique weapon skins alongside the base game and a "major" story expansion arriving in 2027. Speaking to The Game Business, Lyrical Games boss Blake Rochkind said the decision to price Valor Mortis at $40 came from confidence in the game. "We find ourselves as one of the only new IPs launching in what is objectively the craziest fall in the history of this business," Rochkind said. "Not only do you have GTA looming large in November, now you have the Zelda remake, Control coming out in a couple of weeks, Silent Hill: Townfall, Phantom Blade Zero, Gears of War, Call of Duty--by virtue of the development schedule, the cards we’ve been dealt is that we are one of the only new IPs launching this fall." Rochkind added that selling Valor Mortis for $40 allows it to be an "and game," something that players could add to their basket while purchasing one of the high-priced titles out later this year. Having it launch day one through Game Pass also helps it reach players who might have ignored it and probably wouldn't have bought it in the first place. "Game Pass has reached a maturity point in this business where there are 'Game Pass gamers'--people who play games on Game Pass and were unlikely to buy the game day and date anyway," Rochkind explained. "We're happy to be on Game Pass, and I’m not really concerned about cannibalization. For every game that is ‘cannibalized’ by Game Pass, another game gets amazing word-of-mouth because of it." Announced last year, Valor Mortis is a new entry in the souls-like genre, but with a twist—it's in first-person. Set during the Napoleonic Wars, players find themselves exploring European battlefields infested with strange monsters caused by a mysterious, plague-like substance. As a revived Grande Armée soldier known only as William, it's up to you to master strange new skills and powers to stay one step ahead of Napoleon's monsters and their telegraphed attack patterns. Originally scheduled to launch on September 24, Valor Mortis will now launch for PC, PS5, and Xbox Series X|S on October 13.

title: GTA Is Like Barbie, Take-Two Boss Says
description: Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 is one of the most-anticipated game releases ever, and despite the enormous hype, Rockstar and owner Take-Two are going to market the game aggressively. Why does the game even need a marketing push? According to Take-Two boss Strauss Zelnick, just because a franchise is popular and well known, that doesn't mean the company behind it can take their foot off the pedal in terms of spending time and money on marketing. Zelnick said 2023's The Barbie Movie is a good example of this. “All of us saw the Barbie movie, and they marketed the living daylights out of that picture. Even though the IP is very well known. Secondly, it was out there for a while. We all got the joke of what it was going to be. They did a phenomenal marketing campaign. It was really everywhere, and, by the way, it worked," he told GamesBeat. Lucia and Jason in GTA 6.For any "broad-based entertainment" property, companies "don't have a choice" but to spend significantly to push a new release, and GTA 6 is no exception, Zelnick said. "You always have to go out and create enthusiasm. So, awareness is one thing; enthusiasm is another thing. And we have to show people what they’re going to get," Zelnick said. He said Take-Two's investors have asked him why the company needs to aggressively push GTA 6 when it's a game everyone on Earth knows about. Zelnick said he learned from his time as a movie executive years ago that if your product is no good, "you can market the living sh** out of it, and people will still not notice the marketing." And if the marketing is terrible, "you can turn people off." If the marketing is good, however, "you can create more excitmement." "And the whole goal that we always have, whether it’s this upcoming launch or any other title, is to take awareness and turn it into excitement, and take the lack of awareness and turn it into awareness," he said. Also in the interview, Zelnick said Rockstar's partnership with Netflix for the GTA 6 extended trailer was akin to a "tutorial" to help fans see the game in action and understand why they should buy it. “What Rockstar did was incredible, but there was an element of tutorial baked in there, right? It just was a different kind of proposition," he said. "If you look at Rockstar’s marketing previously for Grand Theft Auto titles, there are actual tutorials. This was just a different way of giving the same information, which I thought was really impressive. Rockstar figured out how to do that to entertain us for 27 minutes while also explaining to us how you’re going to play the game." GTA 6 releases on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, with a PC version expected to follow sometime after. In other news, Rockstar just announced GTA 6: The Album, and unlike the game itself, it will be available on a disc.

title: Physint Release Date-Estimate, Gameplay, And Everything We Know
description: After touring the wastelands of extinction-level events in Death Stranding, what's next for Hideo Kojima? The veteran game designer is keeping busy with two projects that Xbox will publish, and one of them is a return to his roots of tactics, espionage, and action: Physint. Still years away, Physint is already building buzz ahead of its eventual release, with new details slowly trickling out as development continues. First revealed during the PlayStation State of Play January 2024 showcase, here's everything that we know about it so far. Physint release date Physint doesn't have a release date yet, and don't expect it to be out for quite some time. Kojima himself has said as much, as the earliest release window for the game could be as far away as 2030. Back in 2025, Kojima said he'd just started work on his horror game OD and that Physint was in a "conceptual" stage of development. Physint platforms With the game so far away, we could be looking at a next-gen release when it does eventually arrive. Now that Xbox has stepped in to publish and help develop it, it's a safe bet that it'll launch for PC and whatever form the next-gen Xbox console, Project Helix, eventually takes. Physint cast Meet the cast of PhysintDeath Stranding 1 and 2 saw Kojima team up with several famous faces to play characters in his post-apocalyptic world, and for Physint, he already has several big names attached to it. Swedish actor Bill Skarsgard (It, Boy Kills World) will play the lead role in the game, and he'll be joined by Charlee Fraser (Furiosa: A Mad Max Saga), Don Lee (Train to Busan), and Minami Hamabe (Godzilla: Minus One). "We are both longtime fans of each other's work, and we've decided to embark on this new adventure together," Kojima said in a press statement about the casting of Skarsgard. "The costume fittings, scans, and camera tests we conducted with Bill and Charlee earlier this year gave me tremendous confidence in the direction of the project." Physint gameplay The first poster for PhysintSo far, the only glimpse we've had of Physint to date is a teaser poster featuring the game's protagonist, cloaked in shadows. The tagline for the game is "here comes the feeling," and Kojima has teased that Physint will "break the barrier" between movies and games. That's not an unusual approach for him to take, given that his projects usually have multiple lengthy cutscenes, and Kojima is aiming to push the limits of video game graphics to new heights. "If your mother walks in and sees you playing this game, she'll think you're watching a movie. I'm not sure how far we can take it yet," Kojima said in a HideoTube episode. We also know that Physint will be a spiritual successor to Kojima's Metal Gear Solid series. The developer says that he was inspired to develop Physint after recovering from a severe bout of illness during the COVID pandemic; he wanted to respond to fan requests to create another Metal Gear. Having already proven that he could still create original experiences with Death Stranding and OD, Physint was born from a desire to respond to his fanbase. Physint development https://youtu.be/NzzdyORdg80 Physint was originally being developed in partnership with PlayStation, but its parent company Sony later confirmed that it would no longer be working with Kojima Productions on it. The official statement never provided a reason why Sony decided to drop the game, but scuttlebutt from around the industry suggested that the Death Stranding games hadn't generated massive returns for the time and money spent on them. According to a Bloomberg report, people familiar with the project had expressed concerns about Physint’s development, as it had reportedly missed deadlines and was going over budget. Fortunately, Xbox stepped in to save the project. "We're honored that Kojima-san has chosen Xbox to work with Kojima Productions on Physint," Xbox CEO Asha Sharma said in a statement. "His ambition to challenge conventions reflects the kind of creativity we want to support at Xbox." Kojima assured fans that despite the change in publishers, development on Physint "is ongoing and will continue moving forward," even in its current early phase.

title: MS Flight Sim Adds New Plane That Costs More Than The Game, And It Includes “Waste” Simulation
description: Microsoft has announced the next DLC for Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024, and it's a plane that costs more than the game itself. The Airbus A380 is now in the game, and you can get it for $74.50. For comparison, the game itself costs $70. It is a digital version of the "superjumbo," four-engine, wide-body airliner made by Airbus. For people who aren't up to date with this kind of the thing, the A380 is the world's biggest commercial passenger plane, with 10 airlines operating them, including Emirates, British Airways, Qantas, and Lufthansa. There are fewer than 200 in service around the world. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xpjx_tQLgPo The developers worked with longtime partners iniBuilds to make the A380 for Microsoft Flight Simulator. It's part of the game's "Exclusive Series," which means it will only be available for three months. According to the developers, the in-game A380 is a highly detailed, carefully crafted virtual version of the plane, featuring "full fight deck modeling" and "extensive interactive controls, displays, and aircraft systems." The plane features a long list of details to mirror its real-life counterpart, even including "potable water and waste simulation." Here's to hoping the pee and poop simulation systems aren't too realistic. The plane also has "functional on-board showers" for its digital recreation in Microsoft Flight Simulator. Check out the extensive blog post to learn more.

title: GTA 6 The Album Gets A Physical Release, Even Though The Game Won’t
description: Rockstar Games has officially announced Grand Theft Auto 6: The Album. The 34-song collection includes original music from people like Keith Richards, Yung Lean, Morgan Wallen, Rauw Alejandro, and more. Rockstar is releasing the album in partnership with Atlantic Records. In addition to a lot of brand-new songs, GTA 6 will feature famous licensed music as well. Check out GameSpot's rundown of all the songs rumored and confirmed for the game so far. The soundtrack releases on November 19 alongside the game, and Rockstar is offering "multiple vinyl and CD" versions at retailers. So yes, GTA 6 will be on a disc, or at least the soundtrack will be. The game itself, though? That's a digital exclusive. For now, Rockstar released six debut singles that can be streamed today. These include: Yung Lean - "That's It" (feat. Future & Metro Boomin) Travis Scott - "RHYNO" (prod. by Guy-Manuel de Homem-Christo) CA7RIEL & Paco Amoroso, PinkPantheress, Fred again.. & Etienne de Crécy - "Sexy Magic" Morgan Wallen - "Last Thing You Need" Rauw Alejandro - "Macacoa 2000" Keith Richards - "Bright Lights, Big City" https://open.spotify.com/prerelease/0kRaNkRxpO16BjxJU0IQAL?si=wXY0s1lZS5KHmpEudqLJfA&utm_source=copy-link&nd=1&dlsi=07d37b60699447f2 You can preorder multiple versions of GTA 6: The Album now, including a limited-edition vinyl for $125, the standard-edition vinyl for $50, and on a CD for $20. The limited-edition vinyl offering comes with two transparent magenta discs "filled with blue liquid." As you can see in the image below, it looks great. Rockstar also said fans can look forward to more music-related GTA 6 announcements to come soon. "Stay tuned for more details about the music of Grand Theft Auto VI, including the dynamic score, the next evolution of in-game radio, and more," the studio said. The $125 limited-edition vinyl looks pretty snazzy.The announcement of GTA 6's official soundtrack comes just after a number of famous artists posted teasers that suggested something was in the works. Music has always been a big part of the GTA series, and that trend is expected to continue with GTA 6. The franchise is known for its numerous in-game radio stations featuring real, licensed music from world-famous artists. It was previously rumored that GTA 6 will feature people like DJ Khaled hosting his own in-game radio station. Drake, meanwhile, may have his own station, too. GTA 6 launches on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. The game is expected to be a huge hit, but anyone who bought stock in the company’s owner is hurting currently.

title: Hideo Kojima’s Physint Casts Bill Skarsgard As Its Lead
description: Bill Skarsgard has been cast in the lead role of Hideo Kojima's upcoming action-espionage game, Physint, Kojima Productions has announced. The project is being developed in partnership with Xbox after PlayStation stepped away from the game earlier this year. Known for his roles in It, John Wick, and Boy Kills World, Skarsgard will take the role of the player character in the game alongside previously announced cast members including Charlee Fraser, Don Lee, and Minami Hamabe. https://youtu.be/NzzdyORdg80 Kojima has previously described Physint as an action-espionage game that will blur the line between games and movies, bringing together talent from both industries. The game's title remains largely provisional, and details about its story and gameplay are still being kept under wraps. However, during the Xbox at Tokyo Game Show broadcast, Kojima also explained that the game is "unbound by any existing genres in digital entertainment." Bill Skarsgard takes the lead role in Physint.Physint was originally being developed with PlayStation, but PlayStation Studios withdrew from the project in June. Kojima subsequently spent around three months looking for a new partner before reaching an agreement with Xbox. The deal expands the existing relationship between Xbox and Kojima Productions, who are also working together on the experimental horror game OD. Kojima Productions and Xbox have also said they intend to explore film and television projects together, expanding their collaboration beyond games. There is currently no release date for Physint, but the game is expected to arrive after OD, which is further along in development.

title: Kingdom Hearts Has Invaded Fortnite, And There’s A Lot To Collect
description: Kingdom Hearts has officially landed in Fortnite, and as expected, the update has brought plenty of cosmetics and weapons to the game. The content includes the Kingdom Key, a weapon Epic says can be used to clobber opponents and call down a shocking bolt of lightning when you need to clear the battlefield. If you're running low on health and shields, you can also grab a Sea Salt Ice Cream to top them up for the battles that lie ahead. But once you're underneath the heart-shaped moon on the ol' Fortnite island? That's when you can start using Kingdom Hearts Overrides to your advantage. Players can activate a Recovery Override to gain healing orbs whenever they eliminate another player equipped with a weapon, while the Level Up Override will spawn a Mythic Kingdom Key for each squad member at their current location. Players can also take part in the Kingdom Hearts Power Hour, starting on Saturday, September 19. This will take place at the following times: 11 AM PT - 1 PM / 2 - 4 PM ET 6 - 8 PM PT / 9 - 11 PM ET If you're looking to dress your Fortnite avatar up in some Kingdom Hearts threads, the new Sora, Riku, Kairi, and Roxas skins are now available. Each one comes with its own Back Bling, Pickaxe, and Lego Fortnite style. While Kingdom Hearts 4 will launch in 2027, it looks like Fortnite's crossover will help fill the gap until that long-awaited sequel finally arrives--plus, it's cathartic to see Kairi get a chance to kick some butt for once. Ahead of Kingdom Hearts 4's launch, it looks like the game was recently caught up in a massive data breach. If you're not afraid of spoilers, you can click through to take a look at the list of worlds that players can probably explore--if the leaked achievements are correct--which includes Coco and a few other surprise IP in the mix.

title: Xbox At Tokyo Game Show 2026: All The Biggest Announcements And Trailers
description: The Tokyo Game Show kicked off this week, and Xbox dropped a new broadcast showcasing what its Japanese partners are up to. The Japanese market has been a tough nut to crack for Microsoft--especially with Sony and Nintendo enjoying a home-field advantage--but Xbox has had a presence there for the last 20 years. Hosted by Misuzu Araki, this year’s Xbox TGS broadcast offered exclusive content and new gameplay. It also took place at a very early hour for anyone residing across the pond, and we're betting that you might have been sleeping when it was on. Fear not! As usual, we've grabbed all the announcements, and you can read through everything below. This was a compact livestream, mostly focused on smaller games being developed by Japanese and Asian studios, but there were a few pleasant surprises. We got a campaign trailer for Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4, Crazy Taxi continues to look wild, and Hideo Kojima even popped in to reveal the actors joining him to play characters in his new action-espionage game, Physint. Here's a breakdown of everything that was shown off: Gachiakuta: Breakout https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UYu__vsFa7k The show is kicking off with a new look at the Gachiakuta: Breakout game. If you haven't seen it, it's a pretty cool anime series about the value of trash--no really--and the manga source material is even better thanks to its cool illustrations. It looks like this will be a faithful adaptation, with plenty of action to enjoy. Crazy Taxi https://youtu.be/cL7btLB6YqA A new Crazy Taxi trailer? Yeah yeah yeah yeah! This fresh gameplay video shows off the new Japanese map you can explore with reckless abandon. Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xgMsKUjMzyk The next Call of Duty game is out next month, and once again it looks like we're in for conspiracies, action, and covert operatives spouting military jargon. Call of Duty campaigns are usually good for a weekend of popcorn action fun, and Modern Warfare 4 looks like it'll be a blast as this trailer dives deeper into John Price’s shadow operations. The Xbox TGS cat finally has a name And it really needs to become the brand's mascot! The black Xbox cat appearing in Tokyo Game Show branding is now Midori, as voted for by fans. Persona 4 Revival https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jAnVDKXBXwY&pp=0gcJCSQMAYcqIYzv The next Persona remake, Persona 4 Revival, is out in February 2027, and it continues to look like a slick entry in the fan-favorite franchise. Shape of Dreams: The Starless Path The action co-op roguelite Shape of Dreams is now on console, and if you have an Xbox Game Pass subscription, you can also access it as a day-one release. Wo Long 2: Wings of Ember https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6e6lN24jpA0&pp=ygUZV28gTG9uZyAyOiBXaW5ncyBvZiBFbWJlcg%3D%3D Need some more Wo Long 2: Wings of Ember in your life? This new trailer showcased a ton of combat, a grueling boss battle, and a reminder that the game launches for PC and console in March 2027. Hope in the City https://youtu.be/aeSj0-tQqxY A game where you play through the eyes of an artist, Hope in the City is a narrative mystery game where you have to track down two missing parents. It launches for PC and console on November 10, and it'll also be available through Xbox Game Pass. Bloomwalker https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Doo7mwnVkWA&pp=ygULQmxvb213YWxrZXI%3D A heartfelt crafting adventure set in the fallen world of Luminoa, Bloomwalker will see players travel with a moving house, cleanse the pollution spreading across the land, and free Guardians to help save the day. It has Studio Ghibli vibes to its art direction, which is an automatic win. Faraday Blues https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zN4Um3v1Xcc Vivarium publisher Serenity Forge showed off a new game called Faraday Blues. A visual-novel adventure, it features striking art and a sci-fi story about searching for parents who don't even know that the protagonist exists. Edge of Memories https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ldtC73ce9pE Out on November 5, Edge of Memories is billed as a solo JRPG. It looks like an anime in action, with stylish combat for you to master. Genigods Nuzha https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rMKPwos8R6E An action RPG that mixes in fighting-game mechanics as you take on Chinese legends? Sign us up! Fallout 76: The Slasher https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8i4awqFQkb4 The spooky season is almost here, and Fallout 76 is kicking things off with The Slasher. Available now--and for free--to all Fallout 76 players, this update will see you follow a trail of clues behind a series of gruesome crimes committed by a knife-wielding culprit. Once Human: The Abyss https://youtu.be/0ndx-1xB_yw Once Human is launching its biggest update soon. Ocean Expansion: Isles of Abyss arrives October 22. Raji: Kaliyuga https://youtu.be/m5NYvTtVxfc Developer Nodding Heads Games provided commentary on Raji: Kaliyuga, its third-person action-adventure. Set in a world where a war between gods threatens all realms, the siblings Raji and Darsh set off on a quest to save--or destroy--the universe. Atelier Karia: The Night Kingdom & the Guide of Memories https://youtu.be/EvfLkEvOUJc And back to the JRPG side of the Xbox TGS livestream! Here's a new character trailer for Atelier Karia: The Night Kingdom & the Guide of Memories, featuring the return of Rutger and Lenja from Atelier Yumia. Bloodstained: The Scarlet Engagement https://youtu.be/uk38_iocrA0 Bloodstained is coming back in 2027, and this new trailer showed off some of the gameplay you'll be in for when the Castlevania-inspired action game arrives. Physint https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NzzdyORdg80 Hideo Kojima's return to the world of tactical espionage action includes a few famous faces along for the ride. Swedish actor Bill Skarsgård will portray the lead role in Physint, and the game's cast also includes Charlee Fraser, Don Lee, and Minami Hamabe.

title: Metroid Ravenous Logo Memes Make Phrases Like “Girl Dinner” And “They Took My Ass” Look So Metal
description: Hype emanating from the reveal of Metroid Ravenous has translated into an onslaught of memes after a logo generator circulated online. If you're on Reddit or Bluesky, you may have seen the instantly iconic image of Samus Aran aggressively pinning down a mysterious enemy for consumption, but now accompanied by stupid text like "I ASKED FOR NO PICKLES" in the Metroid Ravenous font. The Pixelframe Design website unveiled a tool that lets anyone input any text and style it to look like the grainy and jagged Metroid Ravenous logo, with four options for the image background. Pixelframe Design previously made similar logo generators for games like GTA 6, The Duskbloods, and famously, Pokopia. https://bsky.app/profile/pixelframe.bsky.social/post/3mvlab7xqde2o The apparent hook of Metroid Ravenous is Samus's need to kill and consume her enemies to survive. Naturally, that has led to food-related memes like a riff on the "55 burgers" scene from I Think You Should Leave, a reference to the viral concept of "girl dinner," or a simple but effective "Om Nom Nom" joke. Literally any wording you put into the generator will look more badass in this font. https://www.reddit.com/r/Metroid/comments/1whfq4q/hungry_samus_thats_it_thats_the_joke/ It's also been amusing to see other video game titles like Hello Kitty Island Adventure in the Ravenous font face, and several other of these memes are just vulgar and gross enough to be hilarious. Don't expect any of this to become official Nintendo marketing material. https://bsky.app/profile/gusbod.bsky.social/post/3mvlioodyv22v The Metroid subreddit was briefly jam-packed with these images, leading to moderators creating a megathread devoted to the meme template. Hilariously, many of the top-upvoted comments are Ravenous memes dunking on the mods. Revealed during the September 2026 Nintendo Direct, Metroid Ravenous is a follow-up to 2021's Metroid Dread and a return to the 2D track of the franchise. While Nintendo hasn't officially commented on who is developing Ravenous, Dread studio MercurySteam hinted that it's behind the upcoming title on social media. Metroid Ravenous releases on January 28, 2027, and a special edition coming with a steelbook and Amiibo figure will also come out.

title: Resident Evil Director Was In Horrible Pain Making The Movie
description: Resident Evil director Zach Cregger has revealed he was going through hell while making the movie, which is about a man going through hell. He told The Hollywood Reporter that he had pneumonia for the first half of filming on Resident Evil. For the second half of production, he had Campylobacter jejuni. This causes diarrhea, and man, that sucks for anyone, but especially if you're trying to film a big-budget, highly anticipated film based on a property with legions of fans and great expectations creatively and commercially. "So I was very, very ill for the whole production, and everything felt so barely in control because my body was failing me," Cregger explained. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mNd1gb19A-c Cregger said he credits his "wonderful, talented" department leads to help him through, while he also praised Resident Evil star Austin Abrams for going above and beyond. He said Abrams is "one of the most can-do, positive people I’ve ever met. I was spoiled by the people around me." Not only was Cregger physically sick while making Resident Evil, he had to deal with freezing-cold conditions in the north of the Czech Republic where the movie was filmed. "We froze our asses off," he said. This wasn't the first time Cregger was dealing with physical turmoil while making a movie. On his last film, Weapons, it was so hot and humid that he needed an IV and directed scenes remotely. Resident Evil releases on September 18, and it's expected to have a huge, record-setting opening weekend. The movie stars Austin Abrams as a medical courier named Bryan who is an "idiot" everyman who finds himself in a world of pain.
